what: ATTACK 1(c) BY ABLATION: how much of the deployed clean verifier's selection comes from the 15.17% of its LoRA capacity that lands on the vision tower?

adapter_composition.STRUCTURAL_FACT: all 192 vision tensors are visual.blocks.*.mlp.{down,gate,up}_proj. The ViT's ATTENTION carries NO adapter capacity at all, because Qwen2.5-VL names it attn.qkv / attn.proj and the recipe's target_modules are q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj. So the 'incidental 15.2% on vision' is feed-forward only, and the spatial-mixing part of the vision tower -- what a laterality question would need -- was never adaptable under this recipe.
